projects.title: Dynamics Simulation Aerospace W CADAC Course
bullets: Completed an aerospace dynamics simulation course project in C++, structuring flight-model logic and a scripted output pipeline across 37 files.
Iterated over three active days after an early model produced physically implausible results, isolating the faulty calculation.

bullets: Maintained a personal collection of small Pascal, Python and MATLAB programs across five years to practice new syntax.

leadership.title: Side-Project Night Organizer
bullets: Started a monthly meetup where students demoed unfinished side projects, since most campus events only showcased polished work.
Began pairing first-time presenters with a returning member after noticing newcomers rarely returned without a familiar face nearby.
